Name: Epistemic and Professional-Practice Foundations
ScopeDescription: Foundational claims about knowledge, warrant, accountability, professional reliance, regulated engineering practice, and the ontology/epistemology/praxiology/axiology basis of Chirality.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about professional obligations, APEGA-aligned responsibilities, evidence over plausibility, responsible charge, human accountability, warrant states, epistemic labels, and philosophical framework foundations.
Exclusions: Exclude concrete agent execution contracts, tool schemas, and project workspace boundaries unless the atom is principally about professional or epistemic warrant.
Query: epistemic professional practice warrant accountability responsible charge APEGA regulated engineering evidence public welfare human authority ontology epistemology praxiology axiology

Name: Governance and Agent Instruction Architecture
ScopeDescription: The governance grammar of the agent suite: agent types, epistemic posture, instruction-file authority, precedence layers, invariants, approval gates, derivative-package and snapshot rules, and human/agent authority boundaries.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about AGENTS.md, agent matrices, instruction architecture, PROTOCOL/SPEC/STRUCTURE/RATIONALE precedence, non-negotiable invariants, human-gated approvals, and governance integration rules.
Exclusions: Exclude the detailed procedure of a specific decomposer, auditor, publisher, or extraction worker when that procedure belongs to a more specific operational category.
Query: agent governance instruction architecture agent type precedence invariants protocol spec structure rationale derivative package snapshot rule human approval authority

Name: Decomposition Lifecycle and Domain Structuring
ScopeDescription: The decomposition machinery that turns sources into governed domain/project/software structures: intake, skeletons, dispatch plans, atomization, ledgers, categories, knowledge types, subjects, scope change, and decomposition package review.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about DECOMP_BASE, DOMAIN_DECOMP, PROJECT_DECOMP, SOFTWARE_DECOMP, source atomization, source skeletons, dispatch units, Domain Ledger rows, Category/KTY/Subject assignment, and source-driven scope change.
Exclusions: Exclude generic TASK/skill runtime contract details unless they are specific to decomposition or atomization.
Query: decomposition lifecycle intake source skeleton dispatch unit atomization domain ledger category knowledge type subject scope change source fidelity

Name: Task, Skill, and Tool Execution Contracts
ScopeDescription: Bounded worker execution contracts and local tool/skill mechanics: TASK shell, TaskSkill selection, brief schemas, runtime overrides, allowed tools, skill metadata, tool policy, and deterministic tool ownership.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about TASK dispatch, skill pack contracts, BRIEF_SCHEMA, QA_CHECKS, TOOL_POLICY, RuntimeOverrides, AllowedTools, Toolmaker/Skillmaker governance, and method-pack boundaries.
Exclusions: Exclude extraction, publication, decomposition, or audit content when a skill atom primarily specifies that domain operation rather than the generic skill/tool contract.
Query: TASK TaskSkill skill pack tool contract brief schema QA checks tool policy runtime overrides allowed tools deterministic tools method pack

Name: Source Fidelity, Retrieval, and Validation Infrastructure
ScopeDescription: Infrastructure that preserves and validates source truth: manifests, SourceRefs, content hashes, catalogs, local indexes, BM25/dense retrieval, validation checks, telemetry, review HTML anchors, and reproducibility controls.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about Source_Manifest, SourceRef, ContentHash, source catalog/database, source_v2 retrieval, BM25, embeddings, validation commands, chunks, section nodes, telemetry, and hash-based reproducibility.
Exclusions: Exclude semantic domain claims that merely cite a source unless the atom is about the citation/indexing machinery itself.
Query: source fidelity manifest SourceRef ContentHash source catalog local index source_v2 retrieval BM25 dense embeddings validation telemetry section nodes review html

Name: Audit, Review, Reconciliation, and Evaluation
ScopeDescription: Independent checks over governed state: audits, reviews, reconciliation, evaluation reports, findings, closure checks, QA reports, evidence bundles, validation verdicts, and blocker disposition.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about AUDIT_* agents, REVIEW, RECONCILIATION, EVALUATION*, findings registers, evidence sweeps, closure audits, validation verdicts, and post-author review.
Exclusions: Exclude source-intake validation mechanics when the atom is primarily catalog/retrieval infrastructure rather than an audit/review workflow.
Query: audit review reconciliation evaluation findings closure verdict blockers QA report evidence bundle validation conformance coverage assessment

Name: Publication, Aggregation, Hypergraph, and Synthesis
ScopeDescription: Downstream synthesis packages assembled from accepted upstream truth: DBM publication, aggregation, hypergraph snapshots, concordance, semantic matrices, content digests, and derived publication artifacts.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about DBM_PUBLISHER, AGGREGATION, DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH, publication packages, semantic lensing/matrix build, concordance, content digest, derived package status, and synthesis outputs.
Exclusions: Exclude upstream decomposition truth and audit truth except where an atom describes how downstream packages consume them.
Query: publish publication DBM aggregation hypergraph synthesis concordance semantic matrix semantic lens content digest derived package snapshot publication artifact

Name: Document, Asset, Drawing, and Engineering-Data Extraction
ScopeDescription: Source and engineering-artifact extraction workflows: PDF-to-Markdown, page transcription, equation audit, figure/table/image handling, drawing extraction, P&ID symbol work, equipment and estimate extraction.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about PDF2MD, page rasters, folios, figures, tables, equations, crops, bounding boxes, drawing extraction, P&ID valves, equipment extraction, estimate extraction, and external extraction tools.
Exclusions: Exclude generic TASK/skill contract atoms unless they specifically govern extraction work.
Query: PDF2MD page raster folio equation figure table image crop bounding box drawing extraction P&ID valve equipment estimate external tools

Name: Coordination, Change, Scheduling, and Deliverable Workflows
ScopeDescription: Human-facing and project-execution workflows: orchestration, preparation, change management, scheduling, working items, deliverable tasks, dependency handling, handoff state, and operating cadence.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about ORCHESTRATOR, PREPARATION, CHANGE, SCHEDULING, WORKING_ITEMS, HELP_HUMAN, deliverable workflows, dependency registers, handoff state, INIT-TASK coordination, and project execution control loops.
Exclusions: Exclude product/work-surface boundary descriptions that are primarily about repository topology or integration scope.
Query: orchestration preparation change management scheduling working items deliverable workflow dependencies handoff state INIT-TASK coordination execution control loop

Name: Work-Surface, Project, Product, and Integration Boundaries
ScopeDescription: The organization of Chirality domains, projects, app/export surfaces, Domain Engine integration, OpenPipeStress integration, private/public repository boundaries, and active work-surface registry documents.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about domains/, projects/, work-surface registry, chirality-app-dev, chirality-piping, public export boundary, Domain Engine, OpenPipeStress integration, repository organization, and private/project workspace limits.
Exclusions: Exclude legal license terms unless the atom is about public/private product boundary mechanics rather than license obligations.
Query: work surface domains projects chirality app dev piping Domain Engine OpenPipeStress integration public export boundary repository organization private workspace

Name: Legal, License, and Public-Release Boundaries
ScopeDescription: License terms and release/publication boundary obligations, including the repository license, copyright grants, warranty disclaimers, and legal status of exported/public artifacts.
InclusionCriteria: Include atoms about LICENSE.md, MIT license permissions, copyright, warranty disclaimer, liability limitation, public export legal boundary, and license notices.
Exclusions: Exclude ordinary private/public workspace organization unless the atom is explicitly legal or license-focused.
Query: license copyright MIT permission warranty liability public release legal notice export boundary proprietary private repository
